data_product_description: This data product provides percentage generic items for CD comparators, including data on prescribing and dispensing data, with a focus on cost associated with branded prescribing of generics.
data_product_overview:
## Access information
To gain access to 'Catalyst', you will be required to input an ID and password:
ID - NHSBSAGuest
Password - Password12345
If the password is locked for any reason the system automatically reinstates the password. This may take up to 20 minutes.

Note that your browser may give you warning that this is part of a data breach. As this is a publicly available user name and password you do not need to take any action and can login using the provided generic user ID and password.

## Data Product Overview
This analysis allows the user to see the proportion of items prescribed and dispensed generically by Region, ICB (Commissioner and Provider views) and Practice. There is a quarterly view and a year on year view.
